$comment: THE SOLE SELECTOR for the Private STT candidate. Checked in, so changing which model users get is
a reviewable commit rather than a URL parameter or a value in someone's browser.
This is an INTERNAL instrument, not a user-facing picker: users get exactly the one candidate named
here. Rollback is editing this file, not emergency engineering.
Valid ids come from frontend/src/services/transcription/candidateRegistry.ts. An unknown or
activation-ineligible id fails boot with a stated reason; it is never silently substituted.
